theme: Quoting both sides without getting run over
title: Two-Sided Quotes on a Tape That Talks Back
strategies: tight symmetric fixed spread, no skew: maximizes fill rate on noise flow but gets picked off whenever informed order flow is present (reproduces the evaluator's naive baseline)
inventory-only skew: mean-revert quotes toward flat position but ignore the order-flow-imbalance signal, so still walks into predictable adverse moves
order-flow-only skew: react to the imbalance signal but never manage inventory, so a lucky run can still blow through the position limit's risk cost

calibration-driven joint policy: regress the resolved calibration window's order-flow-imbalance feature against next-tick returns to size an order-flow skew coefficient, and size an inventory-mean-reversion coefficient off realized volatility, combining both to move out of the way of predictable moves before they happen
